arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Sacks argued the title extinguished before the purchase.
Ms. Halligan argued the 1838 treaty disestablished the reservation.
Mr. Stewart argued the passage of time does not bar the claim.
Mr. Smith argued the Oneidas did not change their position.
